author: Linda Goins Fox
text: I have only had a few problems. It usually works its way out. I put mine toward the back of my arm so I have not knocked one off since I started over 5 years ago. I’m quite pleased with my Sensor 3+.

author: Susan Jenkins
text: I put the sensor on the back of my arm. Inaccurate readings are off 10 to 15 points. I have had very few defective sensors but I have accidentally ripped them out of my arm.
